name: TechGyaan (Quiz)
tagline: Tap fast and let your tech smarts shine!
shortDesc: A high-speed digital quiz testing computer science fundamentals, code comprehension, and tech trivia.
theme: Computer Science fundamentals, Code outputs (Python & C), Internet terminology, Indian Technologies, and General AI knowledge.
rules: The competition consists of 1 single round with 30 questions in total.
Questions 1 to 15 have a strict 15-second answering window.
Questions 16 to 30 ramp up the speed with a 10-second answering window.
Strict Device Limit: Only ONE mobile phone is permitted per team to join and answer via Mentimeter.
Zero AI Policy: Split-screening, search engines, or AI assistance will lead to immediate disqualification.
Top 3 Winners will be awarded based on highest score and fastest response time right after the quiz concludes.

name: Collage Chronicles (Collage Making)
tagline: Snip, stick, and turn headlines into art!
shortDesc: A hands-on design sprint transforming print media and headlines into a visual technological narrative.
topicReleaseNotice: The official topic will be communicated to all registered teams on the previous evening of Day 1 (15th November evening).
rules: Round 1 Only with a dedicated 35-minute making time window.
Must incorporate newspaper cuttings, printouts (black & white / color), and original slogans.
STRICT RULE: Absolutely NO scissor cutting allowed! All tearing, shaping, and contours must be done entirely by hand.
Teams must bring their own craft glue, magazines, newspapers, and printouts.
Judged on creativity, visual storytelling, neatness, and relevance to the announced topic.

name: Pitch Perfect (Product Pitching w/o AI)
tagline: Build your idea, pitch it, and wow the judges!
shortDesc: Prove raw human ingenuity by creating and pitching an original innovative product without relying on AI.
rules: Core Rule: The product cannot use AI to function, and cannot solve problems using AI (e.g. ❌ 'AI-powered smart vacuum' is disqualified; ✔ 'Edible organic colours for kids' or innovative mechanical/bio tools are valid).
Slide Deck Exception: Teams are permitted to use AI solely to design and prepare their presentation slides.
Presentation Time Limit: Exactly 3 minutes to pitch.
Slide Deck Constraint: Maximum 4 slides only in the presentation.
Judged on originality, market practicality, human creativity, and pitching clarity.

name: Mudra Mime (Dumb Charades)
tagline: No words allowed — can your team crack the clue?
shortDesc: High-octane stage charades featuring tech cinema, Indian biopics, and core computer science concepts.
rules: Round 1: 1 question per team with 60 seconds to act and guess. The Top 10 fastest teams advance to Round 2.
Round 2 (Finals): 1 question per team with 40 seconds to act and guess. The Top 3 fastest teams win.
Interference Rule: If any competing team or audience member guesses the answer, points will be awarded to the acting team only!
Strictly Non-Verbal: Zero speaking, no lip syncing, no pointing at physical objects in the hall, and no writing letters in the air.

name: VOX (Debate)
time: Round 1: 9:15 AM – 11:00 AM | Round 2: 12:30 PM – 1:15 PM
tagline: Make your point, defend it, and own the floor!
shortDesc: A high-intensity two-round knockout debate battling crucial technology policy, modern disruptions, and digital ethics.
topicReleaseNotice: Official debate motions and stances (For/Against) will be communicated to the registered teams on Day 1 evening (16th November evening).
rules: Strict Cap: Only 12 teams can register. Registrations will close immediately once 12 teams sign up.
Round 1 (Day 2 Morning, 9:15 AM – 11:00 AM): 12 teams compete head-to-head in 6 matches. 6 winning teams advance.
Round 2 (Day 2 Afternoon, 12:30 PM – 1:15 PM): 6 teams compete head-to-head in 3 matches to decide the Top 3 winners.
Match Structure: Team 1 Proposition: 2 minutes | Team 2 Opposition: 2 minutes | Cross-Examination & Rebuttal: 4 minutes.
Judged on factual strength, logical rebuttals, clarity of argument, and team coordination.

name: Artistry! (Painting / Sketching / Drawing)
tagline: Turn your big idea into a colourful masterpiece!
shortDesc: An expressive live illustrative competition transforming concepts and human emotion onto the drawing sheet.
topicReleaseNotice: The official theme will be communicated to the registered teams on Day 1 evening (16th November evening).
rules: Duration: 1 hour live creative session (11:15 AM – 12:15 PM).
Official A4 drawing sheets will be provided to all teams on spot.
Teams can use paints, sketches, pencils, pens, or pastels (bring your own art supplies).
Strict Anti-Plagiarism: Absolutely NO pre-drawn or pre-painted work allowed! You can plan your concept in advance, but every stroke must be executed live during the 1-hour session.
Judged on conceptual creativity, visual composition, technique, and relevance to the theme.

name: Tech Pictionary (Doodling & Guessing)
tagline: Turn tech into doodles — let the guessing chaos begin!
shortDesc: Fast-paced board challenge turning tech concepts and terminology into sketches for your team to decode.
rules: Time Limit: 45 seconds per turn to draw and decode the clue.
Strict Drawing Rule: DRAWING ONLY! Strictly NO writing letters, numbers, symbols, abbreviations, or speaking hints.
Interference Rule: If any other team or audience member guesses out loud, the presenting team gets the points!
Rankings are decided by least cumulative time taken. The Top 3 fastest teams win!
